newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Sept public sector deficit $479 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Sept public sector deficit $479 mln.

text.p: Argentina's public sector deficit including income from privatizations was $479 million in September, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
It provided no comparative figures, although last month it said preliminary data showed a deficit of $163 million in August.
In the first nine months of the year, the deficit was $3.450 billion.
The third quarter alone saw a deficit of $1.475 billion compared with $1.173 billion in the same period a year earlier.
Discounting privatization income, the deficit was $1.546 billion in the third quarter compared with $1.304 billion in the same quarter a year earlier.
The deficit excluding privatizations in the first nine months of the year was $4.057 billion, up from $2.164 billion in the same period in 1995.
